states.claim: gopherState->buf holds gopherState->len bytes of buffered partial-line data carried over from a previous invocation; when a complete line is assembled, those bytes are copied into line and gopherState->len is reset to 0.
line is a TEMP_BUF_SIZE local buffer into which the current input line (including any carried-over gopherState->buf bytes) is copied; line[llen + 1] is set to '\0' after the copy.
tline is set to point at the start of line, then advanced past the first character so that name points at the remainder of the line.
selector points into line at the first TAB after tline; that TAB is replaced with '\0' and selector is advanced past it.
host points into line at the first TAB after selector; that TAB is replaced with '\0' and host is advanced past it.
port points into line at the first TAB after host; port[0] is overwritten with ':' and the port field is terminated by replacing a following TAB, '\r', or '\n' with '\0'.
escaped_selector is a heap-allocated copy of the escaped selector string, later released with safe_free.
icon_url is assigned a URL returned by mimeGetIconURL for the gopher type, or NULL for GOPHER_INFO.
tmpbuf is a TEMP_BUF_SIZE local buffer that is zeroed before each formatted line is written into it.
entry is set to the StoreEntry pointer held by gopherState.
gopherState->HTML_header_added is set to 1 after the HTML header is emitted.
gopherState->HTML_pre is set to 1 when the header is added.
gopherState->overflowed is set to true when the accumulated line length would exceed TEMP_BUF_SIZE.

executions.claim: Loop continues only while pos < inbuf + len, so each iteration has at least one byte remaining in the input buffer.
left is the number of bytes from pos to the end of the input buffer, so left >= 1 inside the loop.
If lpos is non-null, it points to a newline within the next left bytes and is incremented to point just past that newline; llen is then the line length including the newline.
If no newline is found, llen equals left, the remaining byte count.
After the overflow check, gopherState->len + llen < TEMP_BUF_SIZE, so the combined buffered length plus new line length fits within TEMP_BUF_SIZE.
When the overflow branch is taken, llen is set to TEMP_BUF_SIZE - gopherState->len - 1, so gopherState->len + llen == TEMP_BUF_SIZE - 1.
If no newline was found, llen bytes are copied from pos into gopherState->buf at offset gopherState->len, gopherState->len is increased by llen, and the loop breaks.
When gopherState->len != 0, the existing buffered bytes are copied to line, then llen bytes from pos are copied after them, llen is increased by gopherState->len, and gopherState->len is reset to 0.
When gopherState->len == 0, llen bytes are copied from pos directly into line.
